name: a sleeping lion
description: A lion is asleep across the room with its front paws crossed, flanks rising and falling. It occupies the space and the warmth that something else used to.
looks: Dust-coloured, scarred across the muzzle, and enormous in the calm way of a thing that has never had to prove it.
One ear tracks you around the room. Nothing else moves.
It smells of hot stone and old meat, and the smell is what stops you arguing with it.
says: Lie down if you are going to.
I am not going to be up for hours.
You are letting the heat out, standing there.
emotes: {it} yawns, jaw cracking, and resettles with a long groan.
{it} stretches until the claws show and lets the leg drop.
{it} rolls half over and takes up rather more room than before.
asks: Are you getting in or not?
How long have you been awake? Honestly.
Do you know what was here before me?
